candidates.angle: Krishna calls the person who restrains the body but not the mind a hypocrite
Krishna rejects mere bodily restraint as delusion
the mind can still chase sense objects even when the body is still
candidates.evidence: कर्मेन्द्रियाणि संयम्य... इन्द्रियार्थान् स्मरन् (restrains the organs of action... remembering sense objects)

angle_hi: मिथ्याचारी: दिखावे का आचरण करने वाला

en.intro: Krishna rejects the idea that stopping your hands is enough. Listen to the word he uses for the person who pretends.
en.notice: Krishna calls such a person a mithyachari, a false actor, because he restrains his organs of action but keeps his mind feasting on sense objects.
en.next: Krishna then points to the true path, where a person truly restrains the senses and begins action without attachment.
en.meaning: One who restrains the organs of action but keeps thinking of sense objects in the mind is deluded and called a hypocrite.

hi.intro: कृष्ण शरीर के संयम को काफी नहीं मानते। सुनिए, वे ऐसे व्यक्ति को क्या कहते हैं जो दिखावा करता है।
hi.meaning: जो व्यक्ति कर्मेन्द्रियों को संयमित कर लेता है, पर मन में विषयों का स्मरण करता रहता है, वह विमूढात्मा है, उसे मिथ्याचारी कहा जाता है।
hi.notice: कृष्ण ऐसे व्यक्ति को मिथ्याचारी कहते हैं, क्योंकि वह अपने कर्मेन्द्रियों को तो रोक लेता है लेकिन मन से इन्द्रियों के विषयों को भोगता रहता है।
hi.next: कृष्ण बताते हैं कि सच्चा संयम तब है जब व्यक्ति मन से इन्द्रियों को संयमित करके अनासक्ति से कर्म योग शुरू करता है।

en.intro: Krishna rejects the idea that stopping your hands is enough. Listen to the word he uses for the person who pretends.
en.body: One who restrains the organs of action but keeps thinking of sense objects in the mind is deluded and called a hypocrite. Krishna calls such a person a mithyachari, a false actor, because he restrains his organs of action but keeps his mind feasting on sense objects. Krishna then points to the true path, where a person truly restrains the senses and begins action without attachment.
